changelog: New: Global Extra Buffering setting (Settings → Stream on phone, Settings → Stream → Decoder on TV). On by default — raises the fullscreen player's buffer targets (10s/15s start/rebuffer thresholds, up to 240s max buffered) to trade a slightly slower start/seek for fewer mid-playback stalls on slow or inconsistent IPTV providers. Applies to every server, not per-provider.
